source_documents.title: Excited-State Intramolecular Proton Transfer (ESIPT) Emission of Hydroxyphenylimidazopyridine: Computational Study on Enhanced and Polymorph-Dependent Luminescence in the Solid State

reference_evidence_units.quote: two of its crystal polymorphs in which molecules are packed as stacked pairs and in nearly coplanar conformation exhibit bright excited-state intramolecular proton transfer (ESIPT) luminescence of different colors (blue-green and yellow).
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP
reference_evidence_units.statement: Bright ESIPT emission in two polymorphs.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Reported in earlier work by the same group.

reference_evidence_units.quote: very weak ESIPT fluorescence that is yellow to orange in color in apolar and aprotic cyclohexane, normal blue fluorescence in protic ethanol, and both normal and ESIPT dual fluorescence in THF (Figure 2)
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP

reference_evidence_units.quote: Though HPIP showed very weak ESIPT luminescence in solution, it showed bright luminescence not only in crystals, but also in frozen dilute solutions and polymer matrixes.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP
reference_evidence_units.statement: Emission turns on whenever the molecule is immobilised, packed or not.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The presence of the S0/S1 CI provided the efficient and fast decay process of the excited state, resulting in the low quantum yield of fluorescence in solution.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP
reference_evidence_units.statement: Twisting of the keto S1 to a CI quenches emission in solution.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Therefore, fixation of the torsion angle ϕ at or close to the coplanar conformation in the solid state should be the origin of the observed emission enhancement in the crystalline state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP
reference_evidence_units.statement: Blocked torsion explains the solid-state enhancement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: indicating that the S1-keto state can be regarded as an energy trap to inhibit exciton migration.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP
reference_evidence_units.statement: Exciton migration and excimer formation are inhibited despite stacking.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The fact that no phosphorescence was observed in the solid state or frozen solution at 77 K indicates that no spin−orbit coupling process was involved in the S1 state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Torsion of the central C-C bond in the keto S1 leads to a conical intersection in solution; fixing it in crystals, frozen solution and PMMA turns emission on.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Emission in all solid forms is ESIPT keto emission.
